exposure: women with low levels of social support
cohort: 37 women delivering via emergency C-section, 21 via elective C-section, and 38 through vaginal delivery
finding: Social support may protect against the potential trauma of an emergency C-section, while sense of coherence appears to be a factor in post-natal resilience.
mod_finding: An emergency C-section predicted increased PTSD symptoms at 12 weeks postpartum only in women with low initial social support.
